title: dsh-coderag retrieval eval task
description: One JSON object per line in eval/tasks.jsonl. See eval/README.md.

id.description: Stable task id; unique within the golden set.

query.description: The user query. Must not leak expected paths or symbols.

expect_paths.description: At least one of these workspace-relative paths must be hit.

expect_symbols.description: Optional symbols that must be hit.

must_not_paths.description: Optional precision guard; hitting any of these fails the task.

notes.description: Optional rationale for why this task is designed this way.

added.description: Date this task entered the golden set (YYYY-MM-DD).
